_README: EnergyMind v3 - Tunisian assumptions. All values are engineering assumptions (not measurements), chosen to match typical Tunisian residential practice (STEG low-voltage network 230/400 V 50 Hz, Prosol Elec rooftop PV, LiFePO4 48 V backup kits, hybrid inverters in SBU = Solar-Battery-Utility priority).

type_a_systems._note: PV resized from SimBench generator sizes (19-78 kWp) to Tunisian rooftop sizes; PV shape (1,400 kWh/kWp/yr) kept. Zero export: surplus PV is curtailed when the battery is full (SBU off-grid priority, no injection contract).

dispatch_rule: SBU: PV -> load first; PV surplus -> battery; battery -> load; grid only when SoC <= soc_min (back to battery at soc_back). Loads above the inverter rating are topped up by the grid. During an STEG outage only the essential circuits are fed (heavy thermal loads are shed).

meter_model._note: class 0.5/1 three-phase smart meter; sigmas fitted on clean measured vs ground truth

other_customers._note: non-monitored customers on the same 160 kVA transformer, measured at their feeder head (other_feeders_P_kw)

voltage_dependence._note: ZIP response used during voltage events: P ~ V (constant current), Q ~ V^2 (constant impedance)
